scope: One public-only experiment on a native Linux x86_64 host, distinct from the historical WSL pipe-policy failure

observation.observation_unit_field_note: The pure unit check was a separate build-supervisor invocation, not part of the observation driver invocation.

limits: Protected target combines dumpable=0 and core limit=0; this does not isolate the effect of dumpability on core creation.
No independent kernel trace or eBPF observation; the policy gate does not establish universal collector absence.
Source and binary hashes are artifact pins, not independent proof that the binary was built from the source; provenance rests on the supervised build report and reviewed build procedure.
The historical WSL G1 result is unchanged; no universal G1, whole-backend, credential-channel, real SDK, TLS, or service qualification is claimed.
Read-only postverification passed; no test or experiment was rerun for this publication.
